events.title: 墙里的悄悄话
events.description: 墙纸后面传来细小的回声，好像有谁在用玩具杯子和你说话。
events.descriptionEn: Tiny echoes slip from behind the wallpaper, as if someone is speaking through a toy cup.

choices.result: 纽扣落进口袋，手电光也像是亮了一点。
choices.resultEn: The button drops into your pocket and the flashlight seems a little brighter.

choices.result: 你在回声里找到了更稳定的呼吸节奏。
choices.resultEn: You find a steadier breathing rhythm in the echo.

choices.textEn: Record the echo with a paper tube
choices.result: 纸筒里留下了一段会帮你找路的声音。
choices.resultEn: The paper tube catches a helpful wayfinding echo.

events.title: 会移动的楼梯
events.description: 一截木楼梯慢慢换了方向，狭缝后面露出一个旧工具盒。
events.descriptionEn: A wooden stair slowly changes direction. An old tool box peeks from a narrow gap.

choices.text: 挤过去拿工具（-6 勇气）
choices.result: 木刺擦过手臂，但你找到了一张枕头重击。
choices.resultEn: A splinter scratches your arm, but you find a Pillow Smash card.

choices.result: 你没有惊动楼梯深处的东西。
choices.resultEn: You avoid whatever waits deeper in the stairs.

choices.result: 你搭好了一套临时书本堡垒。
choices.resultEn: You build a quick Book Fort kit.

events.title: 旧玩偶据点
events.description: 旧玩偶靠在小木架上，留下的补给还整齐地摆着。
events.descriptionEn: Old dolls lean against a little wooden shelf, their supplies still neatly arranged.

choices.result: 你找到了一份爆竹包。
choices.resultEn: You find a firecracker pack.

choices.result: 你收好创可贴和备用电池，状态稳定了不少。
choices.resultEn: You gather bandages and spare batteries.

choices.result: 小牌挂在手电旁，提醒你别走得太急。
choices.resultEn: The tag hangs beside your flashlight, reminding you not to rush.

events.title: 反着画的地图
events.description: 一张潮湿的蜡笔地图把小屋画成了上下颠倒的迷宫。
events.descriptionEn: A damp crayon map draws the little house as an upside-down maze.

choices.result: 你学会了更准确地找到地板缝。
choices.resultEn: You learn how to find floor cracks more precisely.

choices.result: 你得到了一小袋纽扣。
choices.resultEn: You collect a small pouch of buttons.

events.title: 卡住的木梯
events.description: 木梯卡在半空，旁边的电池盒里还剩一点电。
events.descriptionEn: A wooden ladder is stuck midair, with a little charge left in a battery box nearby.

choices.result: 你把电池接到手电上。
choices.resultEn: You wire the battery into your flashlight.

choices.result: 绳结突然回弹，但你打开了发明盒。
choices.resultEn: The knot snaps back, but you open the invention box.

events.title: 玻璃弹珠泉
events.description: 浅浅的蓝色汽水从玻璃弹珠下冒出来，咕嘟咕嘟地发着光。
events.descriptionEn: A shallow blue soda spring bubbles under glass marbles, glowing softly.

choices.result: 刺痛很快退去。
choices.resultEn: The sting quickly fades.

choices.result: 你把泉水调成了可携带的药膏。
choices.resultEn: You mix the spring water into portable salve.

events.title: 塞满的衣柜
events.description: 衣柜塞得太满了，随手一拉就会哗啦掉一堆东西出来。
events.descriptionEn: The closet is so crammed that one yank will send everything tumbling out.

choices.result: 你慢慢掏出一小堆纽扣。
choices.resultEn: You slowly fish out a small pile of buttons.

choices.text: 猛力拉开（-5 勇气，随机卡牌）
choices.textEn: Yank it open (-5 courage, random card)
choices.result: 东西哗啦掉出来，但你捡到了一张有用的卡牌。
choices.resultEn: Things come crashing down, but you grab a useful card.

choices.text: 整理衣物角落（+8 勇气，手电 +12）
choices.textEn: Sort the clothes corner (+8 courage, battery +12)
choices.result: 你找到了一条暖和的毯子和半截电池。
choices.resultEn: You find a warm blanket and a half-used battery.

events.title: 会唱歌的水管
events.description: 水管里传来哼唱声，像是小东西在洗澡时自娱自乐。
events.descriptionEn: A humming sound drifts from the pipes, as if a little thing is singing in the bath.

choices.result: 水管里的声音变大了，你的手电也跟着亮了点。
choices.resultEn: The pipe hums louder and your flashlight perks up.

choices.result: 一个小东西从管口探出脑袋，送了你一枚特别纽扣。
choices.resultEn: A little thing pokes its head out and hands you a special button.

choices.textEn: Eavesdrop with a paper cup (noise +1, buttons +15)
choices.result: 你偷听到了藏纽扣的秘密地点。
choices.resultEn: You overhear the secret button stash location.

events.title: 影子木偶戏
events.description: 墙上的影子突然开始表演一出小戏，看起来很有趣。
events.descriptionEn: The shadows on the wall suddenly start a little show. It looks quite entertaining.

choices.text: 加入表演（-4 勇气，获得卡牌）
choices.textEn: Join the show (-4 courage, gain card)
choices.result: 你手忙脚乱地加入，换来了一张珍贵的卡牌。
choices.resultEn: You clumsily join in and earn a precious card.

choices.result: 你看得入迷，心跳也平稳了不少。
choices.resultEn: You are mesmerized. Your heartbeat steadies.

choices.result: 影子生气地缩回去了，但你拿到了纽扣。
choices.resultEn: The shadow angrily shrinks away, but you got the buttons.

events.title: 玩具游行
events.description: 一群小玩具排着队在走廊里行进，领头的是一只穿靴子的猫。
events.descriptionEn: A line of tiny toys marches down the corridor, led by a cat in boots.

choices.result: 你踩着节拍前进，手电也充了点电，但动静有点大。
choices.resultEn: You march to the beat, recharging your flashlight a bit, but making some noise.

choices.result: 猫头领给你戴上一枚旧姓名牌。
choices.resultEn: The cat captain pins an old name tag on you.

choices.text: 拦路收过路费（纽扣 +22，-6 勇气）
choices.textEn: Block the way for toll (buttons +22, -6 courage)
choices.result: 玩具们七手八脚地把你推开，但留下了不少纽扣。
choices.resultEn: The toys push you aside, but leave plenty of buttons.

events.title: 丢失的日记
events.description: 一本翻开到一半的日记本，上面的字迹歪歪扭扭的。
events.descriptionEn: A diary left open to a random page, with wobbly handwriting.

choices.result: 你学会了更快地发现裂缝。
choices.resultEn: You learn to spot cracks more quickly.

choices.result: 日记里藏着不少纽扣。
choices.resultEn: There are many buttons hidden in the diary.

choices.text: 把日记还给主人（+10 勇气，声响 -1）
choices.result: 日记主人感谢了你，还帮你把声音压低了。
choices.resultEn: The diary owner thanks you and helps you stay quiet.

events.title: 发条鸟
events.description: 一只发条鸟蹲在窗台上，翅膀咔哒咔哒地转动。
events.descriptionEn: A clockwork bird perches on the windowsill, its wings clicking as they turn.

choices.result: 发条鸟开心地转了起来，手电也亮了不少。
choices.resultEn: The bird happily spins, and your flashlight brightens.

choices.text: 和发条鸟交换纽扣（-12 纽扣，纪念物）
choices.textEn: Trade buttons with the bird (-12 buttons, keepsake)
choices.result: 发条鸟叼来了一件奇怪的东西。
choices.resultEn: The bird brings back something curious.

choices.text: 拆下发条零件（获得卡牌，声响 +2）
choices.result: 你把零件改装成了一支信号火花。
choices.resultEn: You convert the parts into a Signal Spark.

events.title: 镜子走廊
events.description: 走廊两边全是镜子，每个镜子里都有不同的东西在动。
events.descriptionEn: Mirrors line both sides of the hallway, each reflecting something different moving.

choices.text: 盯着自己的倒影（+6 最大勇气）
choices.textEn: Stare at your reflection (+6 max courage)
choices.result: 你看到镜中的自己变得更加坚定了。
choices.resultEn: You see your reflection grow more resolute.

choices.text: 打破一面镜子（纽扣 +30，-8 勇气，声响 +2）
choices.result: 碎片飞溅，但镜框后面藏着纽扣！
choices.resultEn: Shards fly, but buttons are hidden behind the frame!

choices.textEn: Make a face at the mirror (noise -2)
choices.result: 镜子里的你也做鬼脸回敬，气氛轻松了不少。
choices.resultEn: Your reflection makes a face back, lightening the mood.

events.title: 毯子迷宫
events.description: 悬挂的毯子围成了一个微型迷宫，里面隐约有亮光。
events.descriptionEn: Hanging blankets form a mini maze, with a faint glow inside.

choices.result: 你在毯子迷宫里找到了散落的纽扣。
choices.resultEn: You find scattered buttons in the blanket maze.

choices.text: 从外面掀开毯子（获得卡牌）
choices.textEn: Lift the blankets from outside (gain card)
choices.result: 毯子下面藏着一个书本堡垒。
choices.resultEn: A Book Fort kit was hiding under the blankets.

choices.text: 把毯子裹在身上休息（+12 勇气，手电 +8）
choices.textEn: Wrap up and rest (+12 courage, battery +8)
choices.result: 毯子很暖和，你恢复了些勇气和手电电量。
choices.resultEn: The blankets are warm. You recover some courage and battery.
